data.one_liner: Package Flutter apps into native installers and archives for desktop platforms.
data.what_it_does: Creates OS‑specific bundles such as .dmg, .exe, .msix, .rpm, and tar.gz from a Flutter build. Supports custom packagers, pre‑ and post‑package hooks, and configurable installer options.
use_when: You need to distribute a Flutter app as a native installer for Windows, macOS, or Linux
You want a single Dart/CLI tool to automate packaging in CI pipelines
avoid_when: Your target is only mobile platforms (iOS/Android)
You require a full installer GUI builder with advanced UI customization
strengths: Supports many formats (msix, dmg, rpm, tar.gz, etc.)
Hook system for custom pre/post processing
weaknesses: Limited to desktop targets; no mobile packaging
May rely on external tools (e.g., appimagetool, productsign)
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml and run the CLI; no build_runner needed but external tools must be installed for some formats
